sections.heading: About these terms
sections.body: These terms are an agreement between you and TZed, the operator of this marketplace [legal name, registration number and address to be added before launch]. By creating an account or using TZed you accept them. We may update them; we'll tell you by email or on the site before important changes take effect.

sections.heading: Who can use TZed
sections.body: You must be 18 or older, live in Tanzania or Zambia, and give accurate details. One person, one account. You're responsible for keeping your password safe and for everything done with your account.

sections.heading: What TZed is
sections.body: TZed is a marketplace that connects buyers and sellers of physical goods. Sellers sell their own items; TZed is not the seller and does not own, inspect or deliver the goods. We review listings, record orders, and help when something goes wrong.

sections.heading: Selling on TZed
sections.body:
• Only list items you own and may legally sell, with honest descriptions, photos and prices.
• Every listing is reviewed before it appears. Prohibited items (see the Help centre) are refused or removed.
• Accept or decline orders promptly, keep buyers informed, and deliver what you described.
• Cross-border sellers are responsible for export rules; the buyer handles import duties and customs.

sections.heading: Buying on TZed
sections.body:
• Read the listing and ask the seller questions before ordering.
• Prices converted to your currency are estimates; the price you agree is in the seller's currency.
• Confirm when you receive your item, and report a problem from the order page if something is wrong.
• Cross-border orders may need import duties and customs clearance, which are the buyer's responsibility.

sections.heading: Payment
sections.body: For now buyers and sellers arrange payment between themselves, for example by mobile money or cash on collection. TZed does not take or hold payments. Never pay outside what is agreed on the order, and be wary of anyone asking you to pay a stranger or share codes or PINs.

sections.heading: Using other people's details
sections.body: When an order is accepted, the buyer and seller see each other's name, and the phone number of anyone who chose to share it. Otherwise, talk in TZed messages. Use these details only for that order: never for marketing, never shared with others, and delete them when the order and any problem are finished. Tell TZed straight away if you think someone's details were misused or leaked.

sections.heading: Problems between buyers and sellers
sections.body: Try to sort things out on the order page first. If you can't, report a problem: the TZed team will look at both sides and suggest a fair outcome. TZed can't force a refund while payment happens outside the platform, but we may restrict or suspend accounts that behave unfairly.

sections.heading: Things you must not do
sections.body: Fraud, fake listings or reviews, counterfeit or stolen goods, harassment, spam, asking for payment outside the order, collecting other users' data, or trying to break or overload the site. Don't ask other users for ID documents or national ID numbers.

sections.heading: Reports, moderation and suspension
sections.body: Anyone can report a listing, user or message. TZed admins review reports and may remove content, hide reviews or suspend accounts. We tell you why, and you can reply through support. Every admin action is recorded.

sections.heading: Your content
sections.body: You keep ownership of your listings, photos and messages. You allow TZed to show them on the platform and in its promotion of your listings while they are live.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: TZed is provided as it is. We work to keep it available and safe, but we are not responsible for the goods, the conduct of buyers and sellers, or losses from deals between them, as far as the law allows. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Tanzanian or Zambian consumer law.

sections.heading: Closing your account
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from My account. We may close accounts that break these terms. Accounts not used for 3 years are closed after an email warning.

sections.heading: Law and contact
sections.body: These terms follow the law of the country you live in (Tanzania or Zambia). Questions: contact us through the Help centre.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.body: TZed [legal name and address to be added before launch] runs this marketplace and is the controller of your personal data. We are registered with Tanzania's Personal Data Protection Commission and Zambia's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner [registration numbers to be added]. Data protection officer: [name], privacy@[domain], or through the Help centre.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body:
• Account: name, email, country, password (stored only as a secure hash), language, and when you agreed to these terms.
• Optional: phone number; for sellers, shop name, town, region and description.
• What you create: listings and photos, orders, messages, reviews, reports, support tickets and problem reports.
• Activity: sign-ins, last visit, and security logs with IP address and browser.
• Counts of listing views and cart adds (numbers only, not who viewed).
We do not collect national ID numbers, passport numbers, ID photos, card numbers or mobile money PINs.

sections.heading: Why we use it
sections.body:
• To run your account and the marketplace (our contract with you): show listings, place orders, deliver messages and send account emails.
• To keep TZed safe (our legitimate interest): review listings, handle reports and problems, and prevent fraud.
• To meet legal duties, such as tax records and requests from authorities.
We don't sell your data, and we don't send marketing emails unless you choose to receive them.

sections.heading: Who sees it
sections.body:
• Everyone: a seller's shop name, town, listings and reviews.
• The other person in an order: your name, once the seller accepts. Your phone number only if you chose to share it (sellers in shop settings, buyers in My account); otherwise you talk in TZed messages. Email addresses are never shown.
• TZed admins: what they need to review listings, reports, problems and support requests.
• Service providers who work for us under contract: hosting, email delivery and backups.
• Authorities, when the law requires it.

sections.heading: Data across borders
sections.body: TZed serves Tanzania and Zambia, so a cross-border order shares the buyer's and seller's details with the other country. Our servers are in [country to be confirmed]. Transfers follow both countries' laws, with the approvals they require.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body:
• Expired sessions and used sign-in links: deleted within days.
• Notifications: 12 months.
• IP address and browser in security logs: 12 months.
• Listing view and cart-add counts: 24 months.
• Accounts not used for 3 years: closed after an email warning 30 days before.
• Orders: kept for tax and accounting records even after an account is deleted, shown as "Deleted user".

sections.heading: Your rights
Security
sections.body: Passwords are hashed, connections are encrypted, admin actions are logged, and photos are stripped of hidden location data. If a breach puts your data at risk, we tell the authorities and you as the law requires.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in and protect forms. Your language choice is stored in your browser. No advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: TZed is for people aged 18 and over. We don't knowingly collect children's data; if we find any, we delete it.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We'll update this policy when our practices change, and tell you about important changes by email or on the site.
